description: List invoices with cursor pagination and optional filters. Autumn API: POST /v1/invoices.list. Returns { list, next_cursor }.

customer_id.description: Filter to a single customer by id.

entity_id.description: Filter to a single entity by id (must be paired with customer_id).

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor` (omit / empty for first page).

status.description: Filter by invoice status: draft, open, paid, void, uncollectible.

name: list_invoices
title: List invoices
